key_insight: Repeated-sampling objectives such as pass@k and max@k shift learning pressure toward harder prompts, and their optimal policies can also be obtained with suitably adapted single-sample objectives.
engineering_relevance: KAPPO lets existing policy optimization methods control sharpening—the loss of behavioral coverage during post-training—without requiring multi-completion training.
method: Derive closed-form optimal policies for KL-regularized pass@k and max@k objectives.
Translate these optima into prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformations for standard @1 objectives.
Apply KAPPO after one-time reference calibration, otherwise retaining the existing training procedure.
evidence_signal: Experiments with several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation report control over sharpening, with single-completion training matching multi-completion @k optimizers at a fraction of the cost.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify calibration overhead, benchmark gains, or compute savings, leaving deployment trade-offs to assess.
